scope: #023 direct logical memory; no hardware, B2 or B7 resource credit
implementation_change: Use identical physical DEMs and matching graphs. Evoke one independent Bernoulli flag per joint fault and trajectory, grouping equal exact probabilities and XORing endpoints with the native scatter routine.
admission: Four matching exact-fault replay/speed receipts are required before any qualification. Selection uses runtime and semantic checks, not logical failure counts.
acceptance: Inherit the original 1000- and 1000000-round horizons, both X/Z bases, both nominal and synthetic paired-readout arms, 1024 shots in each fixed cell, and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 1%; no pooling with v1.
futility: Stop starting additional shards of a cell only after observed failures exceed the allowed count for the complete fixed sample. Already running shards may complete.
